entries.6ec40f3fceb86eda: Its sales strength is said to be its ability to make joint proposals as a group, leveraging strong relationships with customers that span container categories. For glass bottles, 60–70% of shipped bottles are remanufactured into new bottles, and for PET bottle preforms, through collaboration with Group company Enton Ishizuka Green Pet Co., the recycled material usage ratio exceeds 50%, said to be top-class in the industry. Paper containers, through collaboration with Oji Holdings Corporation, have a domestic integrated production system from pulp base paper to container manufacturing, and the company's strength is a cost structure less affected by exchange rates. NARUMI bone china in ceramics has a domestic and overseas sales network that enables direct negotiations with the headquarters of many international hotel chains, and produces products of the same quality at two plants: a domestic plant for the Japanese market and an overseas plant for overseas markets. Antibacterial agents are products based on proprietary technology born from glass research, and are deployed globally.

entries.d07c8b41c656a138: The company has revised its long-term vision, 'ISHIZUKA GROUP 2030 – Becoming a Dynamic Company Through Continuous Challenge', and based on it has formulated a three-year medium-term management plan, 'Challenges in New Domains', with fiscal 2027 as its final year. The company states that it will deepen its existing businesses and take in related peripheral businesses, promote initiatives that emphasize profitability across the whole group including functional subsidiaries, and actively commit management resources to new businesses to create businesses that will become future pillars. It also states that it will work on developing mid-career and young talent, reducing CO2 emissions (PDCA cycle management based on a company-wide optimal roadmap), and creating spare capacity by promoting paperless operations and moving away from analog work.
entries.d413c8529f312722: The group, made up of the company and its subsidiaries, 21 companies in total, manufactures and sells glass bottle-related products, housewares-related products, paper container-related products, plastic container-related products, industrial materials-related products and other products, and conducts businesses incidental to these. From the current consolidated fiscal year, the reportable segments have been changed from five categories to three: “Packaging Container-Related Business,” “Housewares-Related Business” and “Industrial Materials-Related Business.” Consolidated subsidiaries include, in housewares, Aderia Co., Ltd. and Narumi Seitō Co., Ltd.; in plastic containers, Uisuton Co., Ltd. and Nihon Parison Co., Ltd.; and in paper containers, Ishizuka Oji Paper Packaging Co., Ltd., among others.
